technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage existing Spring Boot and Spring Cloud abstractions for dependency management and configuration.
Implement dependency resolution using Maven/Gradle repository mechanisms or custom resolution logic.
Follow the undeploy strategy outlined in the provided PR for consistency with jobs and streams.
Use Spring's profile support to abstract backend strategies in the Admin application.
Design metrics endpoints using Spring Actuator or similar for easy dashboard integration.
Adopt containerization best practices for DockerHub publishing.
assumptions: The developer has access to the existing codebase and is familiar with Spring Framework and Spring Cloud Data Flow.
Standard development, testing, and deployment environments are available, including CI/CD pipelines.
No major external dependencies or third-party integrations require significant additional effort beyond the user stories.
The effort estimates include time for basic testing and documentation but not extensive user acceptance testing.
Assumes the specifications and references (e.g., PR) are sufficient for implementation without further clarification.

activities.activity_description: Investigate and design mechanisms to include or exclude message bus/binding jars for binding selection and fallback when none is configured.
Add support for resolving dependencies to handle cases where modules use different versions of jars, ensuring correct runtime inclusion.
Configure and implement the process to publish the s-c-d image to DockerHub, enabling incremental pushes of latest commits.
Produce a public screencast demonstrating the firehose/counter pipe and the development experience of s-c-s.
Implement the undeploy operation for singlenode (single JVM) to undeploy running streams, based on the strategy from the provided PR.
Introduce support for profiles in the core Admin application to back the stream repository with different backend strategies, such as local in-memory storage.
Brainstorm and design the foundation to port XD modules as s-c-s modules, establishing a base for future migration.
Add support to expose counter (metrics) endpoints for consumption by dashboards, facilitating demonstration of the firehose/counter pipe.
